performance_anchor.name: marginal_anchor
performance_anchor.reason: generic deterministic marginal encoder-decoder retained only as a performance floor

sources: Distribution Regression with Sliced Wasserstein Kernels (Meunier et al., 2022)
kernel_response_distribution.adoption: train-only fixed random-feature proxy for response/item-difficulty distributions; no author code copied

audit.reason: the response-distribution representation fails the preregistered proxy on all three datasets and is materially worse on MOO

peer_completion.adoption: independent response-conditioned CD mapping; no author code or disentanglement model copied
peer_completion.activation: MOO plus at least one of Junyi/EdNet must pass train-only pseudo-holdout audit

audit.reason: neither newly admitted dataset supplies the required second positive peer-completion signal

wasserstein_flow.adoption: independent CD proxy; no author core model copied

audit.reason: four-step flow proxy is worse than the exact-parameter capacity control on all audited datasets

meta_implicit.adoption: independent CD implementation; no author core model copied

audit.reason: the exact-parameter capacity control is better on S, H, and T; MOO also loses every external axis, so the two-dataset activation gate is logically unreachable

current_blocker.evidence: the non-contribution anchor has four strict validation wins, but Peer, Flow, Meta and the post-r29 response-distribution direction all failed their predeclared attribution gates
current_blocker.local_input_audit: the seven admitted protocol directories expose only row identity, student/exercise/concept IDs, labels and Q; no stable exercise text, course hierarchy or item-metadata mapping is available across multiple datasets
current_blocker.why_this_blocks_next_replacement: remaining untried cold-start transfer mechanisms require common semantic/course-resource features, while graph/query/low-rank/gate routes were explicitly prohibited or already rejected
needed_to_resume: admit stable item/concept side information with reproducible ID mappings for at least two datasets
or authorize one explicitly prohibited complete relation/query mechanism for a new clean screen
